# Nature

> Nature is the world's leading multidisciplinary science journal, publishing peer-reviewed research, news, and analysis across biology, physics, chemistry, and medicine.

Nature.com provides access to the Nature journal (ISSN 0028-0836) and Nature Portfolio publications, featuring breaking research discoveries, expert analysis, and subscription options for scientists and researchers worldwide. The site covers cutting-edge topics including genome editing, immunotherapy, regenerative medicine, neuroscience, and climate science.

## Key Topics

- Genome editing
- CAR T cell immunotherapy
- Regenerative medicine
- Neuroscience
- Climate science
- Molecular biology
- CRISPR research
- Bioengineering
- Paleoclimate
- Quantum computing
- Nuclear physics
- Materials science
- Nature journal
- Nature+ subscription
- Peer-reviewed research

## Core Journal Access

- [Subscribe to Nature](https://www.nature.com/nature/subscribe): Subscription options for Nature journal and Nature+ product access including print, online, institutional, and gift subscriptions
- [Latest Science News, Discoveries and Analysis](https://www.nature.com/news): News aggregation hub for breaking science discoveries and research analysis across all disciplines
- [Volume 651 Issue 8106, 19 March 2026](https://www.nature.com/nature/current-issue): Current issue of Nature journal with research highlights and editorial content
- [Reviews & Analysis](https://www.nature.com/nature/reviews-and-analysis): Collection of peer-reviewed research reviews and analysis articles from Nature

## Biomedical Research

- [A Gene-Editing Method Generates Immunotherapeutic CAR T Cells in the Body](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00634-5): In vivo CAR T cell generation via gene-editing for cancer immunotherapy without ex vivo cell manipulation
- [Intestinal Interoceptive Dysfunction Drives Age-Associated Cognitive Decline](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-10191-6): Nature research on gut-brain signaling and microbiome aging affecting memory function and cognitive health
- [Stress Can Cause Eczema to Flare Up – Now We Know Why](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00876-3): Research on stress-induced eczema neurons by Shenbin Liu at Fudan University revealing neurobiological mechanisms
- [Lab-Grown Oesophagus Restores Pigs' Ability to Swallow](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00936-8): Paolo De Coppi's bioengineered oesophageal tissue research for regenerative medicine and organ transplantation
- [Masked Mitochondria Slip Into Cells to Treat Disease in Mice](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00869-2): Mitochondrial transplantation therapy for genetic disease developed by Francis Crick Institute researchers

## Genome Editing & Genetics

- [Genome Editing That Avoids Immune Detection to Integrate Large DNA Sequences](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00730-6): Novel genome editing method for large DNA integration without triggering immune activation responses
- [Daily Briefing: Static Electricity is Still a Mystery — Here's What We Know](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00904-2): Daily science briefing covering static electricity, sports brain injury, and CRISPR research developments

## Physics & Materials Science

- [Elusive 'Nuclear Clocks' Tick Closer to Reality — After Decades in the Making](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00848-7): Nuclear clock breakthrough using thorium-229 isotope by Eric Hudson at UCLA and JILA researchers
- [UK Bets Big on Homegrown Fusion and Quantum — Can It Lead the World?](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00877-2): UK government quantum computing and fusion investment strategy analysis for scientific leadership
- [Hair-Raising: How Carbon Contamination Can Drive Static Charging](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00631-8): Materials science research on carbon-based static charging mechanisms and electrostatic phenomena

## Climate & Earth Sciences

- [Climate Snapshots Trapped in Ancient Ice Tell a Surprising Story](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00636-3): Antarctic ice core paleoclimate research on mid-Pleistocene climate transitions and historical climate patterns

## Mathematics & Awards

- [Mathematician Who Reshaped Number Theory Wins Prestigious Abel Prize](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00819-y): Gerd Faltings wins Abel Prize for groundbreaking contributions to number theory at Max Planck Institute

## Optional

- [Project Hail Mary Film Builds Dazzling New Worlds — and Grounds Them in Science](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00870-9): Film review of Project Hail Mary starring Ryan Gosling based on Andy Weir's scientifically-grounded novel
